name: tcp-udp-path-perf-review
title: TCP/UDP path structural performance review (2026-10)
description: Second-pass structural performance review of the TCP/UDP data paths (capture pump, dispatcher, flow table, TCP redirect, UDP proxy, SOCKS5 transport), following up on 09-29-tcp-udp-path-structural-perf now that F1-F8 have landed. Records the current-state findings (warm-cache clamp accident on both TCP/UDP tables, relay cancellation-token registrations, per-packet Socks5Server string lookup, in-lock policy evaluation, UDP response path traversals and unbatched IOCTLs, per-connection/per-session resource ceilings) and the ranked optimization roadmap. Documentation-only task: no code changes.
